APX_FOLDER_NAME = "000. A.P.X"
LOCAL_INDEX_NAME = "00. index & Links.md"
MCA_NAME = "00. M.C.A.md"

# Extra system folder names that shall never be scanned.
# APX_FOLDER_NAME is intentionally NOT listed here.
# Only this execution root's own A.P.X folder is excluded from MRF.
# Nested "000. A.P.X" folders remain traversable.
EXCLUDED_FOLDER_NAMES = {
    "00. MASKIN LÄSNING",
    "00. MASKINLÄSNING",
}

# Generated MRF files found below the current root are excluded from
# a new MRF aggregation to prevent redundant machine-readable nesting.
# Other nested A.P.X files remain eligible.
GENERATED_MRF_PREFIXES = (
    "00. M.R.F. ",
    "00.MRF. ",
)

# Legacy generated F.R.C folders are excluded if they exist.
EXCLUDED_FOLDER_PREFIXES = (
    "00. MASKINLÄSNING (F.R.C) — ",
)

# Common files that should not become source material.
EXCLUDED_FILE_NAMES = {
    "desktop.ini",
    LOCAL_INDEX_NAME,
    MCA_NAME,
}

# Optional repository metadata.
REPOSITORY_NAME = "RP9.META"

PACKAGE_PURPOSE = (
    "Machine-readable local representation for structured review, "
    "source tracing, cross-document analysis and rapid navigation."
)

PACKAGE_KEYWORDS = [
    "MRF",
    "Machine-Readable Format",
    "A.P.X",
    "local index",
    "source tracing",
    "structured review",
]

SCOPE_STATEMENT = (
    "This MRF contains all includable text-based source material found "
    "inside the selected local root folder at execution time. "
    "A.P.X, hidden folders, explicitly excluded system folders, legacy "
    "generated export folders, the running script and unsupported file "
    "types are not included."
)

PAUSE_AT_END = True


# ============================================================
# ROOT / OUTPUT PATHS
# ============================================================

THIS_SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve()
ROOT = THIS_SCRIPT.parent
BASE_NAME = ROOT.name

APX_PATH = ROOT / APX_FOLDER_NAME

MRF_NAME = f"00. M.R.F. {BASE_NAME}.md"
MRF_PATH = APX_PATH / MRF_NAME
LOCAL_INDEX_PATH = APX_PATH / LOCAL_INDEX_NAME
MCA_PATH = APX_PATH / MCA_NAME


# ============================================================
# DATA MODEL
# ============================================================

@dataclass
class SourceRecord:
    sequence: int
    filename: str
    relative_path: str
    extension: str
    size_bytes: int
    modified_local: str
    line_count: int
    word_count: int
    character_count: int
    sha256: str
    anchor: str
    encoding: str
    read_error: str | None = None


# ============================================================
# SORTING / FILTERING
# ============================================================

def natural_sort_key(value: str) -> list[object]:
    return [
        int(part) if part.isdigit() else part.casefold()
        for part in re.split(r"(\d+)", value)
    ]


def is_hidden_name(name: str) -> bool:
    return name.startswith(".")


def is_excluded_directory(path: Path) -> bool:
    name = path.name

    if is_hidden_name(name):
        return True

    # Exclude only the A.P.X belonging to the root currently being generated.
    # Nested folders with the same name remain traversable.
    try:
        if path.resolve() == APX_PATH.resolve():
            return True
    except OSError:
        pass

    if name in EXCLUDED_FOLDER_NAMES:
        return True

    if any(name.startswith(prefix) for prefix in EXCLUDED_FOLDER_PREFIXES):
        return True

    return False


def is_allowed_source_file(path: Path) -> bool:
    if not path.is_file():
        return False

    if path.resolve() == THIS_SCRIPT:
        return False

    if path.name in EXCLUDED_FILE_NAMES:
        return False

    if is_hidden_name(path.name):
        return False

    # MRF-only exclusion:
    # do not merge nested generated MRF documents into a higher-level MRF.
    if (
        path.suffix.casefold() == ".md"
        and any(path.name.startswith(prefix) for prefix in GENERATED_MRF_PREFIXES)
    ):
        return False

    # Exclude this root's own generated A.P.X output.
    try:
        if APX_PATH.resolve() in path.resolve().parents:
            return False
    except OSError:
        pass

    return path.suffix.casefold() in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS


def collect_source_paths(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    collected: list[Path] = []

    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        current_dir = Path(dirpath)

        dirnames[:] = sorted(
            [
                dirname
                for dirname in dirnames
                if not is_excluded_directory(current_dir / dirname)
            ],
            key=natural_sort_key,
        )

        for filename in sorted(filenames, key=natural_sort_key):
            path = current_dir / filename

            if is_allowed_source_file(path):
                collected.append(path)

    return collected


# ============================================================
# READING / ANALYSIS
# ============================================================

def read_text_robust(path: Path) -> tuple[str, str]:
    encodings = (
        "utf-8-sig",
        "utf-8",
        "cp1252",
        "latin-1",
    )

    last_error: Exception | None = None

    for encoding in encodings:
        try:
            return path.read_text(encoding=encoding), encoding
        except UnicodeDecodeError as error:
            last_error = error
        except OSError:
            raise

    raise UnicodeError(
        f"Could not decode file. Last error: {last_error}"
    )


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()

    with path.open("rb") as file_handle:
        for block in iter(lambda: file_handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(block)

    return digest.hexdigest()


def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    return len(re.findall(r"\S+", text))


def make_anchor(relative_path: str) -> str:
    normalized = relative_path.replace("\\", "/").strip()
    slug = normalized.casefold()

    slug = re.sub(r"\.[a-z0-9]+$", "", slug)
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9åäöæøüß]+", "-", slug)
    slug = re.sub(r"-+", "-", slug).strip("-")

    if not slug:
        slug = "source"

    short_hash = hashlib.sha1(
        normalized.encode("utf-8")
    ).hexdigest()[:10]

    return f"mrf-{slug}-{short_hash}"


def analyze_sources(
    paths: list[Path],
) -> tuple[list[SourceRecord], dict[str, str]]:
    records: list[SourceRecord] = []
    contents: dict[str, str] = {}

    for sequence, path in enumerate(paths, start=1):
        relative_path = path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        stat = path.stat()

        read_error: str | None = None
        text = ""
        encoding = "unread"

        try:
            text, encoding = read_text_robust(path)
        except Exception as error:
            read_error = f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"
            text = (
                "MRF READ ERROR\n\n"
                f"Source: {relative_path}\n\n"
                f"Error: {read_error}\n"
            )

        record = SourceRecord(
            sequence=sequence,
            filename=path.name,
            relative_path=relative_path,
            extension=path.suffix.casefold(),
            size_bytes=stat.st_size,
            modified_local=datetime.fromtimestamp(
                stat.st_mtime
            ).astimezone().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
            line_count=text.count("\n") + (1 if text else 0),
            word_count=count_words(text),
            character_count=len(text),
            sha256=sha256_file(path),
            anchor=make_anchor(relative_path),
            encoding=encoding,
            read_error=read_error,
        )

        records.append(record)
        contents[relative_path] = text

    return records, contents


# ============================================================
# STRUCTURE DATA
# ============================================================

def build_json_tree(records: list[SourceRecord]) -> dict:
    tree: dict = {}

    for record in records:
        parts = Path(record.relative_path).parts
        pointer = tree

        for folder in parts[:-1]:
            pointer = pointer.setdefault(folder, {})

        pointer.setdefault("_files", []).append(parts[-1])

    def sort_tree(node: dict) -> dict:
        sorted_node: dict = {}

        for key in sorted(
            (key for key in node if key != "_files"),
            key=natural_sort_key,
        ):
            sorted_node[key] = sort_tree(node[key])

        if "_files" in node:
            sorted_node["_files"] = sorted(
                node["_files"],
                key=natural_sort_key,
            )

        return sorted_node

    return sort_tree(tree)


def build_ascii_tree(records: list[SourceRecord]) -> list[str]:
    tree = build_json_tree(records)

    def render_node(node: dict, prefix: str = "") -> list[str]:
        lines: list[str] = []

        folder_names = [
            key for key in node.keys() if key != "_files"
        ]
        filenames = node.get("_files", [])

        entries: list[tuple[str, str, dict | None]] = []
        entries.extend(
            ("folder", name, node[name])
            for name in folder_names
        )
        entries.extend(
            ("file", name, None)
            for name in filenames
        )

        for index, (entry_type, name, child) in enumerate(entries):
            is_last = index == len(entries) - 1
            connector = "└── " if is_last else "├── "
            lines.append(f"{prefix}{connector}{name}")

            if entry_type == "folder" and child is not None:
                extension = "    " if is_last else "│   "
                lines.extend(
                    render_node(child, prefix + extension)
                )

        return lines

    return [BASE_NAME, ""] + render_node(tree)


# ============================================================
# MARKDOWN HELPERS
# ============================================================

def human_size(size_bytes: int) -> str:
    value = float(size_bytes)

    for unit in ("B", "KB", "MB", "GB"):
        if value < 1024 or unit == "GB":
            if unit == "B":
                return f"{int(value)} {unit}"
            return f"{value:.2f} {unit}"
        value /= 1024

    return f"{size_bytes} B"


def markdown_escape_table(value: object) -> str:
    return str(value).replace("|", r"\|").replace("\n", " ")


def safe_code_fence(content: str, language: str) -> str:
    matches = re.findall(r"`+", content)
    longest = max((len(match) for match in matches), default=0)
    fence = "`" * max(3, longest + 1)

    return f"{fence}{language}\n{content.rstrip()}\n{fence}"


def format_source_content(
    record: SourceRecord,
    content: str,
) -> str:
    if record.extension == ".md":
        return content.rstrip()

    language_by_extension = {
        ".txt": "text",
        ".py": "python",
        ".json": "json",
        ".csv": "csv",
        ".log": "text",
        ".yaml": "yaml",
        ".yml": "yaml",
    }

    language = language_by_extension.get(
        record.extension,
        "text",
    )

    return safe_code_fence(content, language)


# ============================================================
# MRF METADATA
# ============================================================

def build_metadata(
    records: list[SourceRecord],
    generated_at: datetime,
) -> dict:
    extension_counts = Counter(
        record.extension for record in records
    )

    error_count = sum(
        record.read_error is not None
        for record in records
    )

    folder_paths = {
        str(Path(record.relative_path).parent)
        for record in records
        if str(Path(record.relative_path).parent) != "."
    }

    return {
        "mrf_system": MRF_SYSTEM_NAME,
        "generator_version": SCRIPT_VERSION,
        "repository": REPOSITORY_NAME or BASE_NAME,
        "package_name": BASE_NAME,
        "package_purpose": PACKAGE_PURPOSE,
        "source_root": str(ROOT),
        "apx_folder": APX_FOLDER_NAME,
        "generated_at_local": (
            generated_at.astimezone().isoformat(
                timespec="seconds"
            )
        ),
        "generated_at_utc": (
            generated_at.astimezone(timezone.utc).isoformat(
                timespec="seconds"
            )
        ),
        "output_mrf": MRF_NAME,
        "output_local_index": LOCAL_INDEX_NAME,
        "source_file_count": len(records),
        "source_folder_count": len(folder_paths),
        "total_source_bytes": sum(
            record.size_bytes for record in records
        ),
        "total_characters": sum(
            record.character_count for record in records
        ),
        "total_words": sum(
            record.word_count for record in records
        ),
        "total_lines": sum(
            record.line_count for record in records
        ),
        "read_error_count": error_count,
        "extensions": dict(
            sorted(extension_counts.items())
        ),
        "keywords": PACKAGE_KEYWORDS,
        "scope": SCOPE_STATEMENT,
    }


# ============================================================
# BUILD MRF DOCUMENT
# ============================================================

def build_mrf_document(
    records: list[SourceRecord],
    contents: dict[str, str],
    metadata: dict,
) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 1. IDENTITY
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            f"# 00.MRF. {BASE_NAME}",
            "",
            "## MACHINE-READABLE FORMAT",
            "",
            f"> **System:** {MRF_SYSTEM_NAME}",
            ">",
            f"> **Package:** {BASE_NAME}",
            ">",
            f"> **Generator:** v{SCRIPT_VERSION}",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
            "## MRF METADATA",
            "",
            "```json",
            json.dumps(
                metadata,
                indent=4,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            "```",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 2. SCOPE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## SCOPE",
            "",
            SCOPE_STATEMENT,
            "",
            "### Inclusion",
            "",
            (
                f"- Included source files: "
                f"**{metadata['source_file_count']}**"
            ),
            (
                f"- Included source folders: "
                f"**{metadata['source_folder_count']}**"
            ),
            (
                f"- Included source size: "
                f"**{human_size(metadata['total_source_bytes'])}**"
            ),
            (
                f"- Approximate word count: "
                f"**{metadata['total_words']}**"
            ),
            (
                f"- Read errors: "
                f"**{metadata['read_error_count']}**"
            ),
            "",
            "### Source authority",
            "",
            (
                "The material below is a sequential aggregation "
                "of the original source files."
            ),
            (
                "Each source remains identified by its complete "
                "relative path, filename, type, modification time "
                "and SHA-256 checksum."
            ),
            "",
            (
                "The MRF is a machine-readable review and transport "
                "representation."
            ),
            "It does not replace the original source files.",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 3. MACHINE READING ORIENTATION
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## MACHINE-READING ORIENTATION",
            "",
            (
                "Use the following hierarchy when locating and "
                "interpreting source material:"
            ),
            "",
            (
                "1. Use the **Document Manifest** to identify "
                "the relevant source."
            ),
            (
                "2. Use the complete relative path as the "
                "source's primary identity."
            ),
            (
                "3. Treat repeated filenames such as README.md "
                "as separate documents."
            ),
            (
                "4. Use the source boundary blocks to distinguish "
                "one source from another."
            ),
            (
                "5. Preserve repository order when reconstructing "
                "sequences or derivations."
            ),
            (
                "6. Attribute statements to the original relative "
                "source path."
            ),
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 4. JSON STRUCTURE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## JSON STRUCTURE",
            "",
            "```json",
            json.dumps(
                build_json_tree(records),
                indent=4,
                ensure_ascii=False,
            ),
            "```",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 5. DOCUMENT MANIFEST
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## DOCUMENT MANIFEST",
            "",
            (
                "| Seq. | Source path | Type | Size | Words | "
                "Lines | SHA-256 |"
            ),
            "|---:|:---|:---:|---:|---:|---:|:---|",
        ]
    )

    for record in records:
        lines.append(
            "| "
            f"{record.sequence} | "
            f"[{markdown_escape_table(record.relative_path)}]"
            f"(#{record.anchor}) | "
            f"{markdown_escape_table(record.extension)} | "
            f"{human_size(record.size_bytes)} | "
            f"{record.word_count} | "
            f"{record.line_count} | "
            f"`{record.sha256[:16]}…` |"
        )

    lines.extend(["", "---", ""])

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 6. ASCII TREE
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "## ASCII TREE",
            "",
            "```text",
            *build_ascii_tree(records),
            "```",
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 7. MERGED SOURCE CONTENT
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "# MERGED SOURCE CONTENT",
            "",
            (
                "The following sections preserve the deterministic "
                "source order defined in the Document Manifest."
            ),
            "",
            "---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    for record in records:
        content = contents[record.relative_path]
        formatted_content = format_source_content(
            record,
            content,
        )

        lines.extend(
            [
                f'<a id="{record.anchor}"></a>',
                "",
                "<!-- MRF_SOURCE_BEGIN -->",
                "",
                (
                    f"## SOURCE {record.sequence:04d} — "
                    f"{record.filename}"
                ),
                "",
                (
                    f"**Relative path:** "
                    f"`{record.relative_path}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**File type:** "
                    f"`{record.extension}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**Encoding:** "
                    f"`{record.encoding}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**Size:** "
                    f"`{record.size_bytes}` bytes  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**Modified:** "
                    f"`{record.modified_local}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**SHA-256:** "
                    f"`{record.sha256}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**Words:** "
                    f"`{record.word_count}`  "
                ),
                (
                    f"**Lines:** "
                    f"`{record.line_count}`"
                ),
                "",
            ]
        )

        if record.read_error:
            lines.extend(
                [
                    (
                        f"**Read status:** ERROR — "
                        f"`{record.read_error}`"
                    ),
                    "",
                ]
            )
        else:
            lines.extend(
                [
                    "**Read status:** COMPLETE",
                    "",
                ]
            )

        lines.extend(
            [
                "---",
                "",
                formatted_content,
                "",
                "---",
                "",
                (
                    f"## END SOURCE "
                    f"{record.sequence:04d} — "
                    f"{record.filename}"
                ),
                "",
                "<!-- MRF_SOURCE_END -->",
                "",
                "---",
                "",
            ]
        )

    # --------------------------------------------------------
    # 8. COMPLETION RECORD
    # --------------------------------------------------------

    lines.extend(
        [
            "# MRF COMPLETION RECORD",
            "",
            f"- Package: **{BASE_NAME}**",
            f"- Included sources: **{len(records)}**",
            (
                f"- Read errors: "
                f"**{metadata['read_error_count']}**"
            ),
            (
                f"- Generated: "
                f"**{metadata['generated_at_local']}**"
            ),
            "",
            "The machine-readable aggregation is complete.",
            "",
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"


# ============================================================
# LOCAL INDEX
# ============================================================

def is_local_index_excluded(path: Path) -> bool:
    if is_hidden_name(path.name):
        return True

    if path.resolve() == THIS_SCRIPT:
        return True

    if path.is_dir():
        if path.name in {
            "00. MASKIN LÄSNING",
            "00. MASKINLÄSNING",
        }:
            return True

        if any(
            path.name.startswith(prefix)
            for prefix in EXCLUDED_FOLDER_PREFIXES
        ):
            return True

    return False


def collect_local_index_files(root: Path) -> list[Path]:
    collected: list[Path] = []

    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        current_dir = Path(dirpath)

        dirnames[:] = sorted(
            [
                dirname
                for dirname in dirnames
                if not is_local_index_excluded(current_dir / dirname)
            ],
            key=natural_sort_key,
        )

        for filename in sorted(filenames, key=natural_sort_key):
            path = current_dir / filename

            if is_local_index_excluded(path):
                continue

            if (
                path.is_file()
                and path.suffix.casefold() in ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS
            ):
                collected.append(path)

    return collected


def local_obsidian_link(file_path: Path) -> str:
    """
    Creates an Obsidian wikilink with an explicit alias:

        [[TARGET|LINK NAME]]

    The complete source path is the unique target identity.
    The filename stem is used as the visible link name.
    """
    resolved = file_path.resolve()

    try:
        relative_inside_apx = resolved.relative_to(APX_PATH.resolve())
        relative_target = relative_inside_apx
    except ValueError:
        relative_target = resolved.relative_to(ROOT.resolve())

    # Obsidian Markdown links conventionally omit the .md suffix.
    # Every other supported file type must retain its suffix so that
    # the link resolves to the actual attachment/source file.
    if file_path.suffix.casefold() == ".md":
        target = relative_target.with_suffix("").as_posix()
        link_name = file_path.stem
    else:
        target = relative_target.as_posix()
        link_name = file_path.name

    return f"[[{target}|{link_name}]]"


def folder_sort_key(folder_name: str) -> tuple[int, list[object]]:
    if folder_name == APX_FOLDER_NAME:
        return (1, natural_sort_key(folder_name))
    return (0, natural_sort_key(folder_name))


def build_local_index(index_files: list[Path]) -> str:
    lines: list[str] = []

    lines.extend(
        [
            "> [!abstract] **RP9** 🜁 — **index & Links** 🔗",
            ">",
            ">> ",
            ">",
            "> ---",
            "> ",
            f"> ### **📂 — {BASE_NAME}**",
            "> ",
            ">> ###### **🜁 — Links 🔗**",
            ">> ",
            "> ---",
            "> ",
        ]
    )

    if not index_files:
        lines.extend(
            [
                ">> - ###### No supported source files were found.",
                ">",
                "> ---",
                "",
            ]
        )
        return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"

    grouped: dict[str, list[Path]] = {}

    for file_path in index_files:
        relative_path = file_path.relative_to(ROOT)
        folder = relative_path.parent.as_posix()
        folder = folder if folder != "." else BASE_NAME
        grouped.setdefault(folder, []).append(file_path)

    ordered_folders = sorted(grouped.keys(), key=folder_sort_key)

    for folder_index, folder in enumerate(ordered_folders):
        lines.append(f"> #### 📂 {folder}")
        lines.append(">")

        files = sorted(
            grouped[folder],
            key=lambda p: natural_sort_key(p.name),
        )

        for file_path in files:
            lines.append(
                f">> - ###### 🔗**{local_obsidian_link(file_path)}**"
            )

        lines.append(">")

        if folder_index != len(ordered_folders) - 1:
            lines.append(">---")
            lines.append(">")

    lines.extend(
        [
            ">---",
            "",
        ]
    )

    return "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"


# ============================================================
# ATOMIC WRITE
# ============================================================

def atomic_write_text(
    path: Path,
    text: str,
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    temporary_path = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + ".tmp")

    temporary_path.write_text(
        text,
        encoding="utf-8",
        newline="\n",
    )

    os.replace(temporary_path, path)


# ============================================================
# MAIN PROCESS
# ============================================================

def generate_apx() -> tuple[Path, Path]:
    generated_at = datetime.now().astimezone()

    print("=" * 72)
    print(MRF_SYSTEM_NAME)
    print(f"A.P.X LOCAL GENERATOR v{SCRIPT_VERSION}")
    print("=" * 72)
    print(f"ROOT: {ROOT}")
    print(f"A.P.X: {APX_PATH}")
    print()

    source_paths = collect_source_paths(ROOT)

    if not source_paths:
        raise RuntimeError(
            "No includable source files were found in the root folder."
        )

    print(f"FOUND: {len(source_paths)} source files")
    print()

    records, contents = analyze_sources(source_paths)

    for record in records:
        status = "ERROR" if record.read_error else "ADDING"
        print(
            f"{status}: "
            f"{record.sequence:04d}/{len(records):04d} "
            f"{record.relative_path}"
        )

    metadata = build_metadata(records, generated_at)

    mrf_document = build_mrf_document(
        records,
        contents,
        metadata,
    )

    APX_PATH.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    # 1. Create MRF from the source scan where A.P.X is excluded.
    atomic_write_text(MRF_PATH, mrf_document)

    # 2. Perform a NEW scan for Local Index.
    #    This scan intentionally includes A.P.X, the generated
    #    Markdown files and any existing M.C.A file.
    local_index_files = collect_local_index_files(ROOT)

    # index. Local.md does not exist yet on a first run.
    # Add its intended path explicitly so the generated index
    # is complete already after one execution.
    if LOCAL_INDEX_PATH not in local_index_files:
        local_index_files.append(LOCAL_INDEX_PATH)

    local_index_files = sorted(
        local_index_files,
        key=lambda path: natural_sort_key(
            path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
        ),
    )

    local_index = build_local_index(local_index_files)
    atomic_write_text(LOCAL_INDEX_PATH, local_index)

    print()
    print("=" * 72)
    print("COMPLETE")
    print(f"MRF:        {MRF_PATH}")
    print(f"LOCAL INDEX:{LOCAL_INDEX_PATH}")
    if MCA_PATH.exists():
        print(f"M.C.A:      PRESERVED — {MCA_PATH}")
    else:
        print("M.C.A:      NOT PRESENT — NOT CREATED")
    print("=" * 72)

    return MRF_PATH, LOCAL_INDEX_PATH


def pause_if_requested() -> None:
    if not PAUSE_AT_END:
        return

    if sys.stdin is not None and sys.stdin.isatty():
        try:
            input("Press ENTER to close...")
        except EOFError:
            pass


if __name__ == "__main__":
    exit_code = 0

    try:
        generate_apx()
    except Exception as error:
        exit_code = 1
        print()
        print("=" * 72)
        print("A.P.X GENERATION FAILED")
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")
        print("=" * 72)
    finally:
        pause_if_requested()

    raise SystemExit(exit_code)

END SOURCE 0052 — MRF_1.5.20 COR.py

META-ABSTRACT

META-ABSTRACT

Code 3 — Meta Equilibrium Relational Validator checks exact proportional, reciprocal, complementary, scale, and representational relations within the RP9 / P.B.F. Expansion.
Version 2.1.0 includes exact positional difference, arithmetic reconstruction, relative quotient, positional order, and terminating decimal reconstruction. These additional calculations use positions already calculated by the program’s Base-10 and binary machine-scale controls.

Authoritative arithmetic uses exact rational values. Terminating decimal representations are constructed through integer arithmetic, independently of a fixed Decimal precision.

Go to: ⟶ NAVIGATION & LINKS

RP9 🜁 — NAVIGATION & LINKS 🔗

📂 — C. CODE 3

🜁 — Links 🔗

📂 000. A.P.X. 2.C.D4

  • 🔗 NAVIGATION & LINKS

1. PURPOSE AND INPUT BASIS

The program checks the relations encoded in its controls and records their operations, observations, and status.

Its source basis includes the established P.B.F. rational relations, the assigned functional positions 6–9, Base-10 scaling, and the binary64 machine-scale reference.

The program performs its calculations without reading external numerical data files or accepting an alpha decimal continuation as calculation input.

The rational starting relations and functional position assignments are explicitly encoded in the source. The controls identify their assigned roles and calculate the resulting arithmetic relations.

2. CONTROL ARCHITECTURE

Control Function
C3_T01 Exact complementary closure: 3/4 + 1/4 = 1.
C3_T02 Reciprocal direction: (2/3) × (3/2) = 1.
C3_T03 Binary normalization of 3/2 to 3/4 and its complement 1/4.
C3_T04 Equivalent representations: 3/4 = 6/8 and 1/4 = 2/8.
C3_T05 Complete eight-position complementary closure.
C3_T06 Directional numerical representation through 6/9 and 9/6.
C3_T07 Registration of the assigned functional positions 6, 7, 8, and 9.
C3_T08 Retention of position 7 using the preceding directional and position controls.
C3_T09 Three successive exact divisions by 10: 7 → 0.7 → 0.07 → 0.007.
C3_T10 Numerical distinction and explicit scale relation between 7 and 0.007.
C3_T11 Binary machine-scale crosscheck: 2^-52 → 2^-49, with quotient 8.
C3_T13 Exact difference between calculated positions.
C3_T14 Exact arithmetic reconstruction from anchor and difference.
C3_T15 Exact relative quotient and multiplicative reconstruction.
C3_T16 Positional order and agreement with positive difference.
C3_T17 Exact terminating decimal encoding and rational reconstruction.
C3_T12 Final inspection of recorded provenance fields and specified retired numerical strings.

C3_T12 runs last, after the additional controls. Its original identifier is retained.

3. INTEGRATED POSITIONAL CALCULATIONS

The additional controls compare two pairs of calculated positions:

Source control Anchor Compared position
C3_T09 Calculated third scale step: 0.007. Calculated second scale step: 0.07.
C3_T11 Initial exact machine-scale position: 2^-52. Calculated position after three doublings: 2^-49.

For each pair, the program calculates:

  • The exact difference.
  • The reconstructed position.
  • The exact relative quotient.
  • The positional order.
  • Exact terminating decimal representations of the anchor, position, and difference.

These operations check arithmetic consistency of the calculated positions. Reconstruction confirms recovery of the compared position from its anchor and calculated difference.

The recorded relative quotients are 10 for the Base-10 pair and 8 for the binary machine-scale pair.

4. EXACT REPRESENTATION

The program uses Python’s Fraction for exact rational arithmetic.

The decimal formatter factors the reduced denominator into powers of 2 and 5, then constructs the terminating decimal using integer arithmetic.

It raises an error when the rational value has no terminating Base-10 representation. Such values remain available in exact fraction form.

The relative-quotient helper rejects a zero anchor. The positional-order helper supports ABOVE, BELOW, and EQUAL.

The machine-scale control additionally compares its exact reference with the runtime’s binary64 spacing at 1.0 and machine epsilon.

5. EXECUTION

Requirement: Python 3.9 or later, using the standard library.

Run:

python3 CODE_3.py

The program creates 2. OUTPUT beside the executable and writes:

Output file Contents
CODE 3_CONTROL.txt Control statuses, source descriptions, operations, and notes.
CODE 3_DATA.json Structured control results and detailed calculation evidence.
CODE 3_REPORT.md Control summary, functional chain, and global status.

Running the program again replaces these three generated outputs.

The process returns 0 when all controls pass and 1 when a control reports failure.

6. RESULT INTERPRETATION

The global result is:

  • COMPLETE RELATIONAL LOCK — every implemented control reports PASS.
  • RELATIONAL BREAK — at least one implemented control reports FAIL.

The recorded execution of version 2.1.0 produced 17 PASS controls.

The additional decimal checks confirmed exact reconstruction under reduced Decimal precision, including negative, zero, integer, and long terminating values. Nonterminating decimal conversion and division by a zero anchor were also checked.

The global result applies to the implemented conditions and their stated source basis.

C3_T07 registers encoded functional assignments. C3_T12 checks descriptive provenance fields and two specified retired strings in serialized control results. These controls should be read according to those implemented operations.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import asdict, dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
from fractions import Fraction
import json
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

PROGRAM_ID = "CODE3"
PROGRAM_TITLE = "CODE 3 — META EQUILIBRIUM RELATIONAL VALIDATOR"
VERSION = "2.1.0"
PASS = "PASS"
FAIL = "FAIL"

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ControlResult:
    control_id: str
    title: str
    status: str
    source: str
    operation: str
    output: str
    evidence: dict[str, Any]
    note: str

def ftxt(x: Fraction) -> str:
    return str(x.numerator) if x.denominator == 1 else f"{x.numerator}/{x.denominator}"

def fraction_to_decimal_string(value: Fraction) -> str:
    """Format a terminating rational exactly using integer arithmetic only."""
    denominator = value.denominator
    twos = fives = 0
    while denominator % 2 == 0:
        denominator //= 2
        twos += 1
    while denominator % 5 == 0:
        denominator //= 5
        fives += 1
    if denominator != 1:
        raise ValueError("Fraction has no terminating Base-10 representation.")
    places = max(twos, fives)
    scaled = abs(value.numerator) * 2 ** (places - twos) * 5 ** (places - fives)
    sign = "-" if value < 0 else ""
    if places == 0:
        return sign + str(scaled)
    digits = str(scaled).zfill(places + 1)
    return (sign + digits[:-places] + "." + digits[-places:]).rstrip("0").rstrip(".")


def dec(x: Fraction) -> Decimal:
    """Construct an exact Decimal without context-dependent division."""
    return Decimal(fraction_to_decimal_string(x))


def exact_positional_difference(position: Fraction, anchor: Fraction) -> Fraction:
    return position - anchor


def exact_reconstruction(anchor: Fraction, difference: Fraction) -> Fraction:
    return anchor + difference


def exact_relative_quotient(position: Fraction, anchor: Fraction) -> Fraction:
    if anchor == 0:
        raise ZeroDivisionError("Relative quotient requires a nonzero anchor.")
    return position / anchor


def positional_order(position: Fraction, anchor: Fraction) -> str:
    return "ABOVE" if position > anchor else "BELOW" if position < anchor else "EQUAL"

def check(cid, title, source, operation, output, evidence, condition, note):
    return ControlResult(cid, title, PASS if condition else FAIL,
                         source, operation, output, evidence, note)

def t01():
    y, x = Fraction(3,4), Fraction(1,4)
    return check("C4_T01","PRIMARY COMPLEMENTARY CLOSURE",
        "P.B.F. exact differentiated relation: 3/4 <-> 1/4",
        "exact rational closure","3/4 + 1/4 = 1",
        {"Y":"3/4","X":"1/4","whole":ftxt(y+x)}, y+x==1,
        "The complementary P.B.F. relation closes exactly.")

def t02():
    a,b=Fraction(2,3),Fraction(3,2)
    return check("C4_T02","RECIPROCAL DIRECTION CONTROL",
        "P.B.F. directional reading: 2/3 <-> 3/2",
        "reciprocal inversion","(2/3) * (3/2) = 1",
        {"contained":"2/3","expanded":"3/2","closure":ftxt(a*b)},
        a*b==1 and Fraction(1,a)==b,
        "Direction changes; reciprocal closure is preserved.")

def t03():
    expanded=Fraction(3,2)
    normalized=expanded/Fraction(2,1)
    complement=1-normalized
    return check("C4_T03","BINARY NORMALIZATION CONTROL",
        "expanded reciprocal position 3/2 and binary whole 2",
        "(3/2) / 2","3/4 <-> 1/4",
        {"normalized":ftxt(normalized),"complement":ftxt(complement)},
        normalized==Fraction(3,4) and complement==Fraction(1,4),
        "Binary normalization returns the established P.B.F. proportion.")

def t04():
    return check("C4_T04","DIMENSIONAL PROJECTION CONTROL",
        "P.B.F. planar relation 3/4 <-> 1/4",
        "exact equivalent representation in an eight-position structural frame",
        "3/4 = 6/8 ; 1/4 = 2/8",
        {"Y_planar":"3/4","Y_eight":"6/8","X_planar":"1/4","X_eight":"2/8"},
        Fraction(3,4)==Fraction(6,8) and Fraction(1,4)==Fraction(2,8),
        "The representational frame changes; the exact proportions do not.")

def t05():
    whole=Fraction(6,8)+Fraction(2,8)
    return check("C4_T05","COMPLETE EIGHT-POSITION STRUCTURAL REFERENCE",
        "dimensional P.B.F. representation: 6/8 <-> 2/8",
        "complementary closure inside the eight-position frame",
        "6/8 + 2/8 = 8/8 = 1",
        {"Y":"6/8","X":"2/8","complete_reference":"8/8","whole":ftxt(whole)},
        whole==1,
        "No 3+3 construction is used. This is the exact dimensional P.B.F. representation.")

def t06():
    c,e=Fraction(6,9),Fraction(9,6)
    return check("C4_T06","DIRECTIONAL NUMERICAL REPRESENTATION",
        "P.B.F. reciprocal direction: 2/3 <-> 3/2",
        "directional numerical representation",
        "6/9 = 2/3 ; 9/6 = 3/2",
        {"contained_PBF":"2/3","contained_position":"6/9",
         "expanded_PBF":"3/2","expanded_position":"9/6",
         "reciprocal_closure":ftxt(c*e)},
        c==Fraction(2,3) and e==Fraction(3,2) and c*e==1,
        "6 and 9 are opposing directional numerical positions; they are not produced by counting X.")

def t07():
    positions={"expansion_direction":6,"center_scale_passage":7,
               "complete_circuit_reference":8,"contraction_direction":9}
    ok=positions=={"expansion_direction":6,"center_scale_passage":7,
                   "complete_circuit_reference":8,"contraction_direction":9}
    return check("C4_T07","FUNCTIONAL POSITION TYPE CONTROL",
        "established directional / center / structural position assignments",
        "typed positional registration",
        "6 = expansion ; 7 = center/scale-passage ; 8 = complete circuit ; 9 = contraction",
        positions,ok,
        "The assigned functions are registered without inventing another P.B.F. generator.")

def t08(r6,r7):
    ok=r6.status==PASS and r7.status==PASS
    return check("C4_T08","POSITION-7 CENTER / SCALE-PASSAGE LOCK",
        "established P.B.F. directional representation and functional position assignment",
        "retain position 7 as the established center/scale-passage position",
        "6 — 7 — 8 — 9 functional positional architecture",
        {"directional_control":r6.status,"position_control":r7.status,
         "expansion":6,"center_scale_passage":7,"complete_circuit":8,"contraction":9},
        ok,
        "No separate upstream position-7 generator is introduced.")

def t09(r8):
    p0=Fraction(7,1)
    p1=p0/Fraction(10,1)
    p2=p1/Fraction(10,1)
    p3=p2/Fraction(10,1)
    return check("C4_T09","BASE-10 INVERSE SCALE PROJECTION",
        "established center/scale-passage position 7",
        "three successive exact /10 scale displacements",
        "7 -> 0.7 -> 0.07 -> 0.007",
        {"upstream":r8.status,"step1":str(dec(p1)),"step2":str(dec(p2)),
         "step3":str(dec(p3)),"fraction":ftxt(p3)},
        r8.status==PASS and p3==Fraction(7,1000) and dec(p3)==Decimal("0.007"),
        "The coefficient 7 is preserved while its Base-10 scale position changes.")

def t10():
    seven=Fraction(7,1); projected=Fraction(7,1000)
    return check("C4_T10","FUNCTION / REPRESENTATION DISTINCTION",
        "7 and its Base-10 projected representation 0.007",
        "numerical distinction plus explicit scale relation",
        "7 != 0.007 ; 7 * 10^-3 = 0.007",
        {"numerically_equal":seven==projected,"projected":ftxt(seven/Fraction(1000,1))},
        seven!=projected and seven/Fraction(1000,1)==projected,
        "Scale projection is not ordinary numerical equality.")

def t11():
    r16=Fraction(1,2**52)
    steps=[r16]
    for _ in range(3): steps.append(steps[-1]*2)
    r15=steps[-1]; q=r15/r16
    spacing=math.nextafter(1.0,math.inf)-1.0
    eps=sys.float_info.epsilon
    return check("C4_T11","BINARY MACHINE-SCALE CROSSCHECK",
        "binary64 spacing at 1.0","three exact x2 binary scale steps",
        "2^-52 -> 2^-51 -> 2^-50 -> 2^-49 ; quotient = 8",
        {"steps":[ftxt(x) for x in steps],"quotient":ftxt(q),
         "runtime_epsilon":repr(eps),"nextafter_spacing":repr(spacing)},
        r15==Fraction(1,2**49) and q==8 and eps==2.0**-52 and spacing==eps,
        "Independent binary-scale crosscheck; it does not originate P.B.F.")

def positional_controls(projection: ControlResult, machine: ControlResult):
    """Compare exact outputs already calculated by T09 and T11."""
    pairs = [
        ("BASE10_SCALE", "C4_T09", Fraction(projection.evidence["step3"]),
         Fraction(projection.evidence["step2"])),
        ("BINARY_MACHINE_SCALE", "C4_T11", Fraction(machine.evidence["steps"][0]),
         Fraction(machine.evidence["steps"][-1])),
    ]
    observations = []
    for name, source_id, anchor, position in pairs:
        difference = exact_positional_difference(position, anchor)
        reconstructed = exact_reconstruction(anchor, difference)
        quotient = exact_relative_quotient(position, anchor)
        observations.append({
            "name": name, "source_control": source_id,
            "anchor": ftxt(anchor), "position": ftxt(position),
            "difference": ftxt(difference), "reconstructed": ftxt(reconstructed),
            "relative_quotient": ftxt(quotient),
            "order": positional_order(position, anchor),
            "anchor_decimal": fraction_to_decimal_string(anchor),
            "position_decimal": fraction_to_decimal_string(position),
            "difference_decimal": fraction_to_decimal_string(difference),
        })
    upstream_ok = projection.status == PASS and machine.status == PASS
    specifications = [
        ("C4_T13", "EXACT POSITIONAL DIFFERENCE", "position - anchor",
         all(Fraction(o["difference"]) + Fraction(o["anchor"]) == Fraction(o["position"]) for o in observations)),
        ("C4_T14", "EXACT ARITHMETIC RECONSTRUCTION", "anchor + difference = position",
         all(Fraction(o["reconstructed"]) == Fraction(o["position"]) for o in observations)),
        ("C4_T15", "EXACT RELATIVE QUOTIENT", "position / anchor",
         all(Fraction(o["relative_quotient"]) * Fraction(o["anchor"]) == Fraction(o["position"]) for o in observations)),
        ("C4_T16", "POSITIONAL ORDER", "compare calculated positions and difference signs",
         all(o["order"] == "ABOVE" and Fraction(o["difference"]) > 0 for o in observations)),
        ("C4_T17", "EXACT TERMINATING DECIMAL ROUNDTRIP", "integer decimal encoding -> exact rational reconstruction",
         all(Fraction(o[key + "_decimal"]) == Fraction(o[key])
             for o in observations for key in ("anchor", "position", "difference"))),
    ]
    return [check(cid, title, "Calculated outputs of C4_T09 and C4_T11", operation,
                  operation, {"pairs": observations}, upstream_ok and condition,
                  "Arithmetic consistency of calculated positions; no additional numerical continuation is generated.")
            for cid, title, operation, condition in specifications]


def t12(results):
    serialized=json.dumps([asdict(r) for r in results],ensure_ascii=False)
    forbidden=["0.0072973525692838015","2973525692838015"]
    present=[x for x in forbidden if x in serialized]
    provenance=all(r.source and r.operation and r.output for r in results)
    return check("C4_T12","GLOBAL ADMISSION / PROVENANCE CONTROL",
        "C4_T01 ... C4_T11 and C4_T13 ... C4_T17", "audit source -> operation -> output",
        "EXTERNAL_NUMERICAL_INPUT = NONE",
        {"provenance_complete":provenance,"retired_values_present":present},
        provenance and not present,
        "Checks recorded provenance fields and specified retired strings; this is not a general derivation proof.")

def run():
    rs=[]
    for fn in (t01,t02,t03,t04,t05,t06,t07):
        rs.append(fn())
    r8=t08(rs[5],rs[6]); rs.append(r8)
    rs.append(t09(r8))
    rs.append(t10())
    rs.append(t11())
    rs.extend(positional_controls(rs[8], rs[10]))
    rs.append(t12(rs))
    status="COMPLETE RELATIONAL LOCK" if all(r.status==PASS for r in rs) else "RELATIONAL BREAK"
    return rs,status

def control_text(rs,status):
    lines=[PROGRAM_TITLE,"="*78,f"Version: {VERSION}","","CONTROL RESULTS","-"*78]
    for r in rs:
        lines += [f"{r.control_id} — {r.title}",f"Status: {r.status}",
                  f"Source: {r.source}",f"Operation: {r.operation}",
                  f"Output: {r.output}",f"Note: {r.note}",""]
    lines += ["GLOBAL STATUS","-"*78,status,"","EXTERNAL_NUMERICAL_INPUT = NONE",""]
    return "\n".join(lines)

def report_text(rs,status):
    rows="\n".join(f"| `{r.control_id}` | {r.title} | **{r.status}** |" for r in rs)
    return f"""# {PROGRAM_TITLE}

**Version:** `{VERSION}`  
**Global status:** **{status}**

## Controls

| ID | Control | Status |
|---|---|---|
{rows}

## Functional chain

```text
P.B.F.
→ RECIPROCAL DIRECTION
→ BINARY NORMALIZATION
→ COMPLEMENTARY CLOSURE
→ DIMENSIONAL PROJECTION
→ COMPLETE EIGHT-POSITION STRUCTURAL REFERENCE
→ DIRECTIONAL NUMERICAL REPRESENTATION
→ CENTER / SCALE-PASSAGE POSITION
→ BASE-10 INVERSE SCALE PROJECTION
→ EXACT POSITIONAL DIFFERENCE / RECONSTRUCTION / QUOTIENT / ORDER
→ EXACT TERMINATING DECIMAL ROUNDTRIP
```

## Global result

```text
{status}
```

```text
EXTERNAL_NUMERICAL_INPUT = NONE
```
"""

def main():
    rs,status=run()
    out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/"2. OUTPUT"
    out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    (out/"CODE3_CONTROL.txt").write_text(control_text(rs,status),encoding="utf-8")
    (out/"CODE3_DATA.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "program_id":PROGRAM_ID,"version":VERSION,"global_status":status,
        "external_numerical_input":"NONE","controls":[asdict(r) for r in rs]
    },indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),encoding="utf-8")
    (out/"CODE3_REPORT.md").write_text(report_text(rs,status),encoding="utf-8")
    print(control_text(rs,status))
    return 0 if status=="COMPLETE RELATIONAL LOCK" else 1

if __name__=="__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
